hero.title: Master of Business Studies (MBS) in Finland
hero.subtitle: Experience world-class academic training and global career pathways in Finland with Edu-Hawk Worldwide.

overview: Finland offers English-taught business master’s programmes with a strong focus on analytical thinking, international markets, sustainable business practices and practical projects.

faq.question: Can I study a Master of Business Studies (MBS) in Finland?
faq.answer: Finland generally offers related qualifications under titles such as Master of Science in Economics and Business Administration and Master of Business Administration. Students searching for MBS should compare these official degree options rather than assume that MBS is the exact qualification title.

faq.question: What is the duration of a business master’s degree in Finland?
faq.answer: Many research-oriented business master’s programmes take two years and carry 120 ECTS credits. Some professionally oriented MBA programmes are shorter or have different study formats.

faq.question: What is the cost of studying business in Finland?
faq.answer: Tuition for many English-taught programmes for non-EU/EEA students typically ranges from €9,000 to €20,000 per academic year. The exact fee depends on the institution and programme. Living expenses are additional.

faq.question: Is IELTS compulsory for a business master’s programme in Finland?
faq.answer: Not always. Universities specify which English tests they accept and whether any exemptions apply. Applicants should check the exact language requirements of their chosen programme before applying.

faq.question: Can I work in Finland after completing a business master’s degree?
faq.answer: Graduates may explore relevant employment opportunities, subject to job availability, employer requirements and applicable immigration rules. Employment is not guaranteed, so students should plan for networking, language development and practical experience during their studies.
